rationales.deterministic-orchestration-v2: form (a) + form (b) — the non-AI JavaScript/Node.js orchestrator advances every milestone through the fixed Strategy → Execution → Verification sequence, invoking LLM-based managers in each phase; it also deterministically routes Apollo's verdict: pass advances to Strategy for the next milestone, while fail returns to Execution with a halved budget until pass or budget exhaustion. The framework was implemented and run largely unattended, so neither census exclusion applies.
